use askama::Template;
use actix_web::{HttpResponse, web};
use std::io::Write;

#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "welcome.html")]
struct WelcomeTemplate {
    username: String,
    items: Vec<String>,
}

// GOOD: write_into renders directly into a pre-allocated buffer, no intermediate String
async fn welcome_page(params: web::Query<Params>) -> HttpResponse {
    let tmpl = WelcomeTemplate {
        username: params.username.clone(),
        items: params.items.clone(),
    };
    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(4096);
    tmpl.write_into(&mut buf).unwrap();
    HttpResponse::Ok().content_type("text/html").body(buf)
}

struct Params {
    username: String,
    items: Vec<String>,
}
